# edge-router
L7 routing and request rewriting for the nimbus edge.

## How changes land here
- Write an intent and an agent takes it, or open a file and edit it yourself. Both become a change.
- Every change leases the symbols it touches. Agents and people share the same leases.
- The verifier merges every change. Branch policy lives in `cinder.toml`.

## Local development
```
cargo test --workspace
cinder checkout c-1042                  # pull any change's workspace
git push cinder HEAD:refs/for/develop   # a push becomes a change
```
